name: Aegiochusmon: Green
look: Aegiochusmon in green leaf armour with two vine whips tipped with spiked pink seed-pods
entry: Aegiochusmon wreathed in living vines. Its whips are tipped with spiked seed-pods that burst into thickets wherever they land, and a forest grows in its footsteps.
how: Wild: rare in hills, plains, forests and jungles.
